new: granblue.team has been rebuilt from scratch with a new design. Teams, profiles, and the search sidebar all work differently, and everything is available in English and Japanese

Added collections. You can keep track of the characters, weapons, summons, and artifacts you own, including uncaps, transcendence, weapon keys, AX skills, and awakenings, and search and filter them from your profile
Added a browser extension for desktop Chromium browsers that imports your in-game collection and teams. See the Extension page for download and setup instructions

When adding items to a team, you can now search your collection instead of every item. Items added from your collection keep their uncap, transcendence, and modifications, and can be synced when your collection changes
Teams now show which items you own at the uncap and transcendence level the team uses
Added artifacts. You can add artifacts to your collection, equip them to characters in your teams, and see the in-game artifact scores
Added crews. You can create or join a crew, scout players, add phantom players for members who don't use the site, and check members' collections from the crew roster
Crews can now track **Unite and Fight** scores for each member and phantom player, with charts of scores across events
You can now share teams with your crew, in addition to setting a team to public, unlisted, or private
You can now build teams from a crewmate's collection, or from any user's public collection from their profile

Added a new filter bar to the Gallery. You can filter teams by element, raid, date, characters, weapons, and summons to include or exclude, battle settings, boost type (**Omega**, **Primal**, **Odious**, or unboosted) and double or single boost, or show only teams you can build from your collection
Redesigned team pages. Raid, battle settings, clear time, button and chain counts, and video now show as tiles above the grid, and the Characters, Weapons, and Summons tabs each have their own link
You can now duplicate weapons and summons in a grid from the context menu, or by holding Alt while dragging to an empty slot
If you made teams without an account, you can now move them to your account after logging in
improved: Added password reset and email verification for accounts
Theme and language toggles are now in the navigation menu, and your choice is saved to your account when logged in
Summons and transcended weapons like **Dark Opus** now show their transformed art based on uncap and transcendence level
Raid pages now list teams for that raid and can be filtered like the Gallery, and the raid picker now has a Farming tab
Teams for **Versusia** now have the extra character slots, and imported teams are assigned a raid automatically when they use extra slots
Weapons with befoulments can now have them set when editing
